evidence: tools/run_ldpc_g2.py imports exactly one name from this module, build_packet_plan; it measured BLER through baseline.ldpc.adapter.SionnaLDPCAdapter directly and never called transmit_transport or receive_transport.
The diff against the measurement commit is confined to transmit_transport and receive_transport: PacketPlan, PacketPlan.metadata, _minimum_rate, _candidate and build_packet_plan are byte-identical.
The other seven files under src/baseline/ldpc/ are byte-identical to the measurement commit; this is the only re-adjudicated path.

spec/evidence/check_packetisation.py still reports 0 failures over all 216 configurations, and tests/test_ldpc.py::test_runtime_packetisation_matches_every_solver_row still reproduces every committed packetisation-record row exactly.

The correction was verified against the committed packetisation record: constructing the Sionna encoder with K' reproduces the TS 38.212 5.2.2 lifting size on all 232 (configuration, E_r) pairs, where K mismatches or errors on 46 of them.
readjudications.justification: transmit_transport and receive_transport were corrected, and receive_transport_verified was added, so that a CRC failure is reported rather than raised and so that the Sionna encoder is constructed with K' rather than K. Neither definition was reachable from the G-2 measurement, so no recorded BLER number, waterfall displacement or packetisation row can depend on the change. G-2's recorded results stand unchanged and no new campaign was run.
